name: CRESTLINE
concept: An original formal luxury hardtop in the 1960s-70s West Coast lowrider tradition (no real make or model): boxy, long and low, flat roof and upright windshield, a padded landau top with chrome S-bars, a wide rectangular face, a squared trunk, long straight body lines and heavy chrome. Rebuilt in 2099 around an electromagnetic hover conversion that looks engineered: machined maglev corner modules on chrome hydraulic actuators. The tiny wire wheels stay as jewellery.
units: metres; +X forward, +Z up, origin at the centre of the footprint on the ground

body.construction: faceted 20-point cross-sections lofted along X, bevel modifier with hardened normals: crisp creases, flat panels

wheels.style: a shrunken custom 13-inch lowrider wire wheel: 100 cross-laced chrome spokes in four lacing groups, a deep-dish polished rim with a proud lip, a recessed chrome hub with gold flanges, a three-wing chrome knock-off with a gold centre

tyre.note: chunky miniature tyre, two tread grooves, fine siping; a thin whitewall on the outboard side only

wheels.note: tiny on purpose; they spin but carry no weight. Each rides on its module's outrigger, 13 cm clear of the module

hover.stack: black anodised emitter plate (slim violet emitter ring underneath) / exposed gold toroidal coil pack / chrome band / brushed titanium dome with ten radial fins / chrome boss with a gold ring and six bolts
hover.mount: parallelogram trailing arms (chrome, gold pivot eyes) from a titanium chassis bracket on a chrome cross-member; a gold-sprung hydraulic strut from the module clevis inboard to a titanium manifold on the centreline; a titanium outrigger and chrome bearing carry the wheel
hover.articulation_note: each module takes back 80 % of the body's bounce, roll and pitch at its corner and stays level with the road; arms and struts follow by constraint
hover.emission: only the emitter rings under the plate (hoverViolet, pulsing with the 808), a 3 W pool per module, and a faint ripple field-print on the road that fades as the car lifts
hover.travel: clamped between a bump stop 3 mm under the floor and a 1 cm field gap above the road: on the slam the body lays down onto the modules

suspension.note: per-corner offsets driven by visual/sync/<cand>.cues.json; kicks bounce, the slam drops all four corners, the hop lifts the nose

lights.head: quad rectangular lamps in chrome bezels
lights.tail: vertical taillight bars at the rear corners + a centre bar
lights.grille: chrome egg-crate over a dark recess

materials.body: candy burgundy: metallic flake base under a burgundy-tinted clear coat
materials.hardware: brushed titanium, black anodised alloy, chrome, gold coil windings and fittings
